offers_products.reason: Produces and sells natural gas, NGLs and power generated from gas; main offering is the commodity.

offers_services.reason: Midstream and carbon capture exist, but revenue is mainly from gas production sales; services are secondary.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells natural gas and power to marketers, pipelines, utilities and power buyers, not households directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Natural gas sold to midstream, marketers and utilities; power to grid and hyperscaler/data-center demand.

recurring_revenue.reason: Continuous natural gas and power sales to repeat buyers under ongoing supply and offtake arrangements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Natural gas and electricity are needed continuously; buyers can't easily postpone, though prices fluctuate.

big_ticket.reason: Frequent, ongoing deliveries of natural gas and power, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from wells, pipelines, power plants and gas reserves, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are large midstream firms, utilities, marketers and investment-grade hyperscalers.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs wells, gathering pipelines, power plants and carbon capture facilities with heavy ongoing capital investment.
